practice_units.title: The Delhi Sultanate Establishment
practice_units.problem: Arrange the following dynasties in chronological order of their rule in Delhi: Tughlaq, Khilji, Slave (Mamluk), Lodi.
guidance: The first was the Slave dynasty (Qutb-ud-din Aibak).
They were followed by the Tughlaqs (Muhammad bin Tughlaq).
The last were the Lodis (Ibrahim Lodi).
practice_units.solution: Slave Dynasty -> Khilji Dynasty -> Tughlaq Dynasty -> Lodi Dynasty.
